text: KEEP Cats Core for the BIDS shared module. Before: datatype/entity, table header/row, and query checks were fail-fast and bespoke traversal remained the only composition helper. After: private BidsValidation.Check uses ValidatedNec to accumulate independent domain BidsIssue values; public checked methods return Either[BidsIssueReport, A], not Cats datatypes; legacy Either[BidsError, A] methods retain deterministic primary-error behavior. Multi-defect tests cover 4 datatype issues, 4 table issues, and 4 query issues. BidsEither remains for genuinely sequential fail-fast parsing/traversal rather than being removed for its own sake. Verification: sbt 'bidsJVM/test' 'bidsJS/test' passed 59 JVM and 52 JS tests warning-clean; git diff --check passed; Cats data types occur only in the private BidsValidation helper.
